tasks.description: Add a 'Forgot password?' link on the login page that opens a form for users to enter their account email to request a reset. This link should be visible and accessible from the login page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is on the login page, when they click the 'Forgot password?' link, then a form to enter their email address appears.

tasks.description: Develop a function to generate single-use, time-limited reset tokens. These tokens should be unique and have a limited lifespan.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when a token is generated, then the token is unique and has a limited lifespan.

tasks.description: Implement a feature to email a reset link containing the generated token to the user's registered email address.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user requests a password reset, when the system generates a reset token, then an email with a reset link is sent to the user's registered email address.

tasks.description: Create a form where users can enter and confirm a new password. This form should be accessible from the emailed reset link and should validate the reset token before accepting the new password.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user follows the reset link from their email, when they enter a new password and confirm it, then the system checks the token's validity before updating the password.

tasks.description: Upon successful reset, hash and store the new password using the existing password-hashing scheme.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when the new password is stored, then it is hashed using the existing password-hashing scheme.

tasks.description: After a successful password reset, invalidate the user's existing sessions to prevent account takeover.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user successfully resets their password, when they try to use an existing session token, then the system rejects the token as invalid.

tasks.description: Ensure the system rejects expired, already-used, or invalid tokens during the password reset process.
acceptance_criteria: Given an expired or already-used token, when a user tries to reset their password, then the system rejects the token and does not update the password.
